title: Flicker Strike Slayer
overview:
Softcore Trade progression from Sunder to Terminus Est, then Rakiata. Finish on a shared Paradoxica and Shako setup with a damage or defence option. Passive trees converted with the 3.30 PoB development build.

Full Duelist quest rewards and gem shopping by act: https://pobb.in/g2YCCNi_FgJE

PoB 3.30 migration: all Flicker trees retained their allocated nodes, selected masteries and socketed jewels. Rakiata, Paradoxica and The Surrender remain the three endgame options. With the same saved combat settings, damage is effectively unchanged. The 3.30 engine estimates 148k eHP for The Surrender, with a 15.9k maximum physical hit.

stages.title: Spectral Throw · Act 1
stages.goal: Use Spectral Throw with Momentum. From level 8 add Added Fire Damage from The Caged Brute in a green-green-red link.
stages.swap: Switch to Sunder at level 12 once you have a two-handed axe.
stages.priority: Buy Spectral Throw from Nessa after Hillock. Take Momentum and Quicksilver after Mercy Mission. Buy Sunder from Nessa at Merveil’s cavern.

stages.title: Sunder · Early campaign
stages.goal: Link Sunder to Ruthless, then Melee Physical Damage and Close Combat.
stages.swap: Keep Sunder through the rest of the campaign.
stages.priority: Get Melee Physical Damage from Silk after Sharp and Cruel and buy Close Combat from Yeena. Replace your axe as damage falls off.

stages.title: Sunder · To Kitava
stages.goal: Use Sunder and Vulnerability for bosses. Add low-level Precision and Determination as mana allows.
stages.swap: Finish the campaign and gather the 4-link Terminus Flicker package.
stages.priority: Buy Determination and Vulnerability from Clarissa after Lost in Love. Take Multistrike in Act 4 and level it with Flicker in your weapon swap. Complete Fallen from Grace in Act 6.
stages.conditions: Keep resistances capped after each Kitava penalty.

stages.title: Terminus Est · First Flicker
stages.goal: Use Flicker Strike, Multistrike, Close Combat and Increased Critical Strikes. Use Poacher’s Mark and Blood Rage.
stages.swap: Switch around level 70 once you have a high-crit Terminus Est, a 4-link, mana leech and close to 100% chance to hit.
stages.priority: Refund 10 ordinary points in Martial Experience and Kinetic Impacts. Follow the sword path for critical strikes and Frenzy generation.
stages.budget: A 4-link and ordinary gems are enough to try the swap.
stages.conditions: Check Frenzy sustain against a lone boss.

stages.title: Terminus Est · Atlas
stages.goal: Add Brutality on a 5-link and Fortify on a 6-link. Use Frenzy of Onslaught to rebuild charges if needed.
stages.swap: Stay here until you have Rakiata, Farrul’s Fur, Aspect of the Cat and the elemental links.
stages.priority: Reach 75% elemental resistance, keep mana leech, and level gems. Take Masterful Form in the fourth Lab.
stages.budget: A cheap 6-link Terminus or a linked rare chest both work.

stages.title: Rakiata · Budget endgame
stages.goal: Use Rakiata’s Dance with regular Farrul’s Fur. Link Less Duration on the item granting Aspect of the Cat and activate the Aspect.
stages.swap: Swap when you have a 6-link, capped resistances, mana leech and enough Intelligence. Refund 19 ordinary points and spend 10 refund points changing Impact to Overwhelm.
stages.priority: Start with a rare life/resistance belt, Darkray Vectors and two rings with −7 mana cost. Add Frenetic to the amulet.
stages.budget: Compare the price of a 6-link chest and a 6-link Rakiata.
stages.conditions: Pinnacle, 8 Frenzy, 3 Power and 30 Rage. Avoid Exposure and Scorch on the resistance-inverting weapon.

stages.title: Paradoxica · Damage
stages.goal: Use Paradoxica, Ice Bite level 33 Forbidden Shako and Light of Lunaris. Cast Frost Bomb on the boss.
stages.swap: Move from Rakiata once Paradoxica, Shako, Aspect of the Cat and the charge engine are ready. Refund 14 ordinary points.
stages.priority: Buy ordinary Multistrike first if Greater Multistrike is expensive. The +1 Frenzy ring and gloves are upgrades.
stages.budget: The chest needs a 4-link for auras. Regular Farrul’s Fur can bridge into Replica.
stages.conditions: Pinnacle, 10 Frenzy, 10 Endurance, 1 Power, 30 Rage and Cold Exposure. Without Replica, use 3 Power and disable Endurance.

stages.goal: Switch to The Surrender, Fortify Support and ordinary Multistrike. Use rare boots with life, spell suppression and movement speed.
stages.swap: Switch directly from Rakiata for 14 ordinary refunds, or from Paradoxica for 3.
stages.priority: Finish chaos resistance on the belt and rings, then check block and mana in PoB.
stages.budget: A rare Tower Shield can cover the block slot. The Surrender recovers life when you block.
stages.conditions: Pinnacle, 9 Frenzy, 9 Endurance, 1 Power, 30 Rage, Cold Exposure and 10 Fortification.
